request.style: Hard rock anthem, powerful male lead vocal in English, distorted electric guitars, driving bass, big live drums, energetic, 140 bpm
request.lyrics:
[verse]
Engines roaring on the highway
neon burning through the rain
we were born to break the silence
we were made to feel the flame

[pre-chorus]
Turn it up and let it shake
every wall we're gonna break

[chorus]
We are the thunder, we are the storm
we light the fire to keep us warm
raise your hands up to the sky
tonight we're never gonna die

[verse]
Every scar is just a story
every fall a reason why
we keep running through the darkness
with the lightning in our eyes

[pre-chorus]
Turn it up and let it shake
every wall we're gonna break

[chorus]
We are the thunder, we are the storm
we light the fire to keep us warm
raise your hands up to the sky
tonight we're never gonna die

[bridge]
Hear the crowd, hear the call
we stand together, we will never fall

[chorus]
We are the thunder, we are the storm
we light the fire to keep us warm
raise your hands up to the sky
tonight we're never gonna die
